editorial_revision.word_count_method: Whitespace-delimited words. Chapter prose counts exclude table rows and displayed equation blocks and include headings and captions.

metric_definitions.finding: IoU and confidence-ordered one-to-one matching remain explicit. Matching uses IoU at least 0.50. Misses, extras and the duplicate subset remain distinct. Precision and recall are fractions. Complete-pair counts retain every reference front with two known corners in the denominator.

confidence_and_availability.finding: Reference availability remains an image-annotation property. Predicted scores select returned points, and pixel distance evaluates accuracy. Accepted corners require finite in-image coordinates and scores at least 0.50. Retained corner scores are described without claiming measured calibration of averaged positions.

coordinate_decoding.finding: Section 5.3 explains heatmap-to-coordinate conversion and actual resize scales. Appendix 11.2 says a heatmap without a valid point records the corner as unavailable, while the correction model updates only usable initial points. Checked decode_heatmaps and replace_points: heatmap failure does not fall back to the old coordinate.

reference_versions.finding: The supplied 664-front and earlier 666-front annotations are explicitly versions of the same 20 evaluation photographs. The main 654-front reference and 658-front inclusion extension remain distinguished. Table 7 holds predictions fixed, and Table 5 holds evaluation annotations fixed while changing training labels. Earlier-reference rank reversal remains visible in text and appendices.

controls_and_comparison_conditions.finding: The untouched supplied checkpoint remains the benchmark and shared initializer. Table 3 retains the adapted single-view input for each refinement comparison. Paired training uses shared initialization, image order, seed, budget, optimizer and final epoch.
